environment.description: AWS API Gateway WebSocket API deployed in us-east-1 with a public endpoint (wss://abc123.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/prod). The WebSocket API has a Lambda authorizer that validates JWT tokens passed as query parameter 'token' on $connect. Once connected, all subsequent frames are processed under the authenticated session. No Origin header validation is configured at any layer. The API Gateway endpoint is publicly routable from any IP address.
